collection.title: Citroen C4 Grand Space Tourer 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen Grand Space Tourer 2018 Onwards model which requires a 32" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 28" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Citroen C4 Grand Space Tourer 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
